note: Light presets (docs/light/PLAN.md). Directions are given in image terms for the front camera; the subject never changes, so the light is the only variable.

forms.setting: standing in the middle of an empty room with plain white plaster walls and a pale wooden floor at night, a fabric-shaded table lamp on a low side table at image-left, visible in frame
forms.desc: the only light is the warm 2700 K table lamp at image-left at waist height, strong warm fall-off across the mannequin from image-left to near darkness at image-right, cozy dim room, soft-edged shadow on the wall to image-right
forms.keep: single warm table lamp at image-left visible, steep fall-off to the right, dim room
checks: 唯一光源是左侧台灯（入画）

forms.setting: standing in an empty office with grey carpet and white walls, a grid of rectangular ceiling light panels visible above
forms.desc: flat even greenish-white 4000 K light from overhead panel lights, low contrast, soft shadows under the chin and arms, slightly clinical mood
forms.keep: even greenish-white overhead panel light, low contrast, clinical

forms.setting: standing in a dark room, three lit candles on a low stand at image-left at hip height, visible in frame
forms.desc: the only light is three candle flames at image-left, very warm 1800 K flickering light, steep fall-off, the mannequin's right side glowing orange and the rest sinking into darkness, black background
forms.keep: three candles at image-left visible, very warm, steep fall-off, black background

forms.setting: standing outdoors at night on bare ground, a small campfire on the ground in front of it at image-left
forms.desc: warm orange firelight from a campfire low in front at image-left, lighting the mannequin from below and the front, upward shadows, sparks rising, dark night forest behind
forms.keep: low campfire in front image-left, warm uplight from below, dark forest behind

forms.setting: standing on a wet city pavement at night beside a dark wall with two blank neon tubes, a magenta one at image-left and a cyan one at image-right, no letters
forms.desc: magenta neon light on the mannequin's right side from image-left and cyan neon light on its left side from image-right, the two colours meeting at the centre line of the figure, colourful reflections on the wet pavement
forms.keep: magenta from image-left, cyan from image-right, colours meeting at the centre, wet reflections

forms.setting: standing on an empty pavement at night under a single old sodium street lamp above and slightly behind it, visible at the top of the frame
forms.desc: a single sodium street lamp above and slightly behind, orange-yellow 2000 K top light, a cone of light on the pavement around the feet, the face and front in shadow, dark blue night around
forms.keep: single sodium lamp above-behind visible, orange cone of light, dark blue night

forms.setting: standing in a dark room facing a large blank glowing monitor just out of frame in front of it at chest height
forms.desc: cool blue-white light from a screen directly in front at chest height, flat cold light on the front of the mannequin and the sphere, everything behind falling into darkness
forms.keep: cool screen light from the front at chest height, flat cold front light, dark behind

forms.setting: standing in front of a dark wall hung with strings of small warm bulbs, the bulbs visible behind it as soft round bokeh
forms.desc: soft warm low light mainly from the many small bulbs behind and around, gentle rim on the outline, front softly lit by a faint warm fill, round bokeh dots in the background
forms.keep: many small warm bulbs behind as bokeh, gentle rim, faint warm front fill

forms.setting: standing on an empty road at night, two car headlights glowing just out of frame low behind the camera
forms.desc: two hard white headlight beams from low in front, bright flat front light on the mannequin, long double shadows cast straight back on the road, dark night beyond
forms.keep: two low headlight beams from the front, flat bright front, long double shadows straight back

forms.setting: standing on a dark wooden stage, black curtains behind
forms.desc: a single hard white spotlight from high in front, a sharp-edged round pool of light on the stage around the mannequin, everything outside the pool black, faint haze in the beam
forms.keep: single hard spotlight from high front, sharp round pool, black outside

forms.setting: standing in the middle of an empty room with plain white plaster walls and a pale wooden floor at dusk, a window at image-right showing blue dusk sky, a warm floor lamp at image-left visible
forms.desc: warm 2700 K lamp light on the mannequin's right side from image-left and cool blue dusk light from the window on its left side from image-right, warm and cool meeting across the figure
